patch.value: Merge-fence scope ambiguity: extension-contributed item folders make default validation disagree with the no-extensions CI baseline

Default extension-aware pm validate and pm merge install include item types contributed by active project extensions, while the repository merge-safety CI deliberately runs both commands with --no-extensions. The same committed .gitattributes can therefore be reported stale locally and over-specified in CI. Define a stable project-schema versus optional-runtime-extension fence contract, surface the selected scope in diagnostics, and ensure one documented command produces the committed baseline without contradictory remediation.

The committed fence has one explicit reproducible schema scope shared by CI and operator guidance; default validation does not recommend a change that the required CI gate reverses; diagnostics name whether core project schema or active extension schema was audited; tests cover tracked project profiles and optional runtime-only profiles without weakening custom item merge protection
pm validate and pm merge install with active project extensions versus --no-extensions CI
Local diagnostics and CI agree on the committed semantic merge-fence contract.
Extension-aware local validation requested ten optional profile folder patterns that the no-extensions CI then removed and rejected.
